source_text:
40 DE ANTECHRISTI TEM.

ORE? Dixit Esaias: Hic homo, qui commouit orbem Et reges totidem, sub quo fiet terra deserta. Audite, quoniam propheta de illo praedixit; Nihil ego conposite dixi, sed lege legendo. Tum scilicet mundus finitur, cum ille parebit Et tres imperantes ipse deuicerit orbe. Cum fuerit autem Nero de inferno leuatus, Helias ueniet prius signare dilectos, Rex quam sub fine regit et artatio tota. In septem annis tremebit undique terra: Sed medium tempus Helias, medium Nero tenebit. Tunc Babillon meretrix incinefacta fauilla Inde ad Hierusalem perget, uictorque Latinus Tunc dicit: Ego sum Christus, quem semper oratis. Et quidem conlaudant illum primitiui decepti Multa signa facit quoniam cuius pseudopropheta. ****** Omnipotens tribuit, ut talis eradat. Recapitulantes scripturas ex eo Iudaei Exclamant pariter ad Excelsum sese deceptos.
pass_a_gloss: Isaiah: man who moves orbem. World ends when he appears. Nero from inferno; Elias seals dilectos. Babylon burned; false “Ego sum Christus.” Jews cry to Excelsum they were deceived.
pass_b_english: Isaiah said: This is the man who shook the globe and as many kings, under whom the earth will be made desert. Hear, for the prophet foretold of him; I have composed nothing — I speak by reading the law. Then of course the world is finished when he appears and himself conquers three rulers in the world. But when Nero has been raised from hell, Elias will come first to seal the beloved, before the king rules at the end and the whole constriction. For seven years the earth will tremble everywhere: but half the time Elias, half Nero will hold. Then Babylon the whore will be burned to ash; from there he will go to Jerusalem, and the Latin victor then says: “I am Christ, whom you always pray.” And indeed the first deceived praise him, since his false prophet does many signs. … The Almighty grants that the spiritual one wipe away. Recapitulating the scriptures from him, the Jews cry together to the Highest that they themselves were deceived.

choices.choose: world ends under the predicted man
choices.why: Tum… mundus finitur, cum ille parebit.
Tunc dicit: Ego sum Christus… pseudopropheta.
